name: Autofill
description: A field can automatically be filled while typing into another one.
project_description:
Description 
 The Autofill module makes it possible to autofill the values from one textfield to another while typing. Once your field input was customized the autofill functionality will be detached.

 Requirements 
 
 Drupal Core 
 
 Installation: 
 Install the Autofill module as you would normally install a contributed Drupal module. Visit https://www.drupal.org/node/1897420 for further information.

 Configuration 
 
 Open the "Manage form display" configuration for your designated content type 
 Click on the widget settings icon for the field that should be autofilled 
 Enable "Autofill from another field" 
 Select the source field from which the field should be autofilled 
 
 
 
 You're looking for jQuery Autofill? 
 The autofill namespace was previously used for the jQuery Autofill module (Drupal 6 only). That module has been archived in a sandbox .
